correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the global map: on each shore vertices with equal initial color remain identical forever; replacing every initial shore/color multiplicity by min(m,2) preserves the threshold-two excited-neighbor Boolean at every step by induction. This proves an exact 3^8=6561-state quotient, not a small-graph extrapolation. Independently iterated all 6561 capped signatures, finding F^11=F^7, and enumerated feasible signatures for a,b up to 8; maxima 4 on (2,2), 5 on (2,3) and (3,3), 6 on (4,4) and (7,7), and 7 on (7,8) and (8,8). Feasible capped signatures stabilize once a,b>=8. Independently checked labelled witness 0011233|00112233 has entry 7 and S/T orbit formula yields Q4(4,4)=18, Q4(4,5)=60, Q4(8,8)=1,615,922. Counting four-color rotating and two-color alternating states then dividing by primitive period four is correct. g0=1, g1=z, g2=e^z-1-z follows labelled EGF partition, so basin coefficient formula is exact. The exhaustive small finite quotient plus its valid capping proof establishes the all-a,b claim; direct finite sample counts alone would not.
